title: ESPN's Jalen Rose Has Strong Message For Mainstream America
htmlContent:
If you have been watching the numerous hours of Kwame Browns rants on Instagram Live and his YouTube channel, the message that you have to watch what you label black men and women.

For over 20 years now, Kwame Brown had to carry the label a bust, something the sports media gave him. Another example, was when Skip Bayless called Chris Bosh “Bosh Spice”. Skip shared that he was just stating that Chris Bosh was soft, but it was taken to mean something different.

Jalen Rose went to IG Live to explain that he had attempted to explain to Stephen A. Smith and Skip Baylessthat it goes beyond just numbers.

When you called somebody Bonafide Scrub who stays with them no matter what, and Smith was still promoting Brown as a few months ago.

When you called somebody Bonafide Scrub who stays with them no matter what, and Smith was still promoting Brown as a few months ago. These kinds of names go beyond basketball. The former 2001 number one pick had a solid career in the NBA, but because of Stephen A. Smith all they remember is him being a bust and Bonafide Scrub.

Kwame Brown would go on to thank Rose for speaking up.
